cases.name: Scale AI, Inc. v. Mercor.io Corporation

pinned_news.headline: Meta Pauses Work With Mercor After Data Breach Confirmed by Startup

profile_text.body:
Mercor is a San Francisco-based startup founded in 2023. On its own site, the company describes itself as organizing human intelligence to power the AI economy, and says it powers frontier research, AI benchmarks, and AI agent training at scale for top AI labs and enterprises. It also says it helps enterprises turn their expertise into production AI, new revenue streams, and the human intelligence behind leading models.

The site names the APEX family of benchmarks, which it says assesses whether frontier AI models can perform economically valuable tasks across professional services, medicine, and software engineering.

Mercor is the defendant in Scale AI, Inc. v. Mercor.io Corporation, filed in the District Court, N.D. California. The company is also recorded as Mercor.io Corporation and is associated with 281 cases in California.
